# Course information

Copied here from the course repository so that questions about the course can be answered from this repository. Updated by the course; do not edit these files.

- [syllabus.md](syllabus.md): the Fall 2026 syllabus, including grading, late work, the exam windows, the project milestones and the AI-use policy.
- [due-dates.md](due-dates.md): every check-in, homework and lab writeup deadline, in Mountain Time, with the date it was last checked against Canvas.
- [this-week.md](this-week.md): the current week's meetings, links and deadlines.
- [office-hours.md](office-hours.md): the instructor's and the teaching assistants' office hours, day by day, with the weekly chart and the link to the live Canvas page.

Canvas is the authority when anything here and Canvas disagree: https://byu.instructure.com/courses/36965.
